(InvenTrust or Company) today announced that it has acquired The Shops at Walnut Creek (Walnut Creek), a 216,325 square foot, 93% leased shopping center located in Westminster, Colorado for $57.1 million. Podboy, Executive Vice President, and Chief Investment Officer of InvenTrust.
